answer.answer: Out of 113 reported zeta-potential values for amine-functionalised polystyrene nanoparticles, 64 are negative (and 49 positive), so the majority are actually negative. These particles are not reliably positively charged; the sign flips depending on the suspension medium (e.g., salt or culture media screen the amine charge), so a blanket 'positively charged' claim is not supported by the data.
